proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width band below the main content ending in a bold tagline ("The best no-code platform for ...") followed by a thin divider row, recurring identically across health-integrations pages.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as the shared site footer fragment (default-content tagline + divider), not page-specific content; author once and reuse. Rejected alternative: treat as a page-level closing CTA block, since content is identical across every integration page and matches footer placement/position, not a per-page CTA.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical tagline text and position recur across all captured health-integration pages, indicating shared site chrome (footer) rather than authored per-page content.

proposed_rules.trigger: An FAQ accordion answer appears as a detached [region] node outside the accordion's own subtree (often below the footer or overlapping the cookie-banner y-range), rather than nested under its question row.
proposed_rules.decision: Fold the orphan [region] text back into its matching question's row in the faq-accordion block as the answer cell; do not model it as separate page content or a new section.
proposed_rules.rationale: Absolutely-positioned expand/collapse answer panels get promoted out of their DOM parent during capture (same overlay-promotion mechanism used for fixed navs/modals), splitting one logical Q&A pair across two tree locations that must be reconciled by matching y-position/order to the accordion.

provenance.evidence: C211 rc2c9 [region] + rc4 [region] (2 detached FAQ-answer nodes)
